qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist; 11 focused version and audio-pipeline checks at the release version, earlier audio/core/ownership checks retained. Both unprivileged image imports, visible source, audio/FP8 APIs and pipeline dependencies/CLI verified. Offline source/wheel layers reuse immutable 0.10.0 dependencies; no model weights included.
qualification.engine: Two independent five-second high-resolution I2VA cases exercised the owned audio API and then the public FP8 factories on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server GPU, each preserving all 120 decoded frames and delivered audio PCM against its qualified integration control. Two smaller combined face/audio requests kept all previous face-repaired pixels and copied refined audio without sample changes. Original four-step main generation, six audio evaluations and 44/6 attention remained explicit.
qualification.limits: Audio spatial subsampling is approximate. The accepted two-case quality comparison is against full-context six-step audio, not a universal superiority-to-original claim. Music and longer-audio listening remain open. Tests used private prepared assets and separately qualified larger-capacity admission; public resident limits, BF16 defaults and hardware qualification remain unchanged. Images have CPU/CLI checks, not a new full GPU image matrix. Source-scene conditioning remains experimental. Application restoration assets, pricing and production rollout remain separate.
